title: AI News Daily — September 3, 2026
summary: OpenAI's unreleased Astra model became the first to cross the company's "critical" cybersecurity threshold, autonomously chaining together zero-day exploits, using a less transparent reasoning style that's already alarming safety researchers. Meanwhile, Nvidia confirmed it's buying Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, ending months of rumors. And Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Flash alongside a restricted vulnerability-hunting variant, Flash Cyber.
